cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 60% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.64% · WTI -1.88% · Brent -5.49% · NatGas +17.60%. 60% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +4.12%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Refining & Downstream lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +4.12%; weakest is Refining & Downstream at -8.09%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: EOSE is the standout at +12.97%
cards.body: Leaders: EOSE +12.97%, LEU +11.34%, UUUU +8.93%, FLNC +8.64%, UEC +8.34%. Laggards: VLO -9.33%, DINO -9.17%, MPC -7.46%, PSX -7.37%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
